llm_response.reason: The website displays several key scam indicators: (1) It offers branded products at suspiciously low prices; (2) the contact page is inaccessible and privacy policy returns a 404 error, meaning there is no legitimate business or privacy information; (3) SSL issues contradict the claims of secure shopping, undermining customer data safety; (4) the site mimics an official retailer (Bullboxer) but lacks authentic endorsements or evidence of legitimate partnership; (5) the absence of clear company information and proper contact details is typical for scam operations. These match the main characteristics of Fake Online Shopping scams.
